title: Extremely functional but at this price, the tray should be flawless & without scratches
text:
Extremely functional but at this price, the tray should be flawless & without scratches. Come tax time my cost for this tray will wind up being less than the $50 advertised price. Had I paid the full $50, I would have been extremely disappointed. I am only somewhat disappointed since I paid less and I have no plans of gifting this.

The tray I received arrived with missing lacquer around the edges and scratches and other imperfections on the side. Although, this is noticeable, it does not take away from the serviceability of this piece. It remains highly functional, sturdy, and a great way to carry food items, coffee, tea, etc. to a porch, in bed, or wherever needed. A friend of mine uses a tray like this on her upholstered ottoman to serve tea on and protect her furniture.

Most of the finish on this tray is stunningly glossy. As can be seen from the first photo, you can see my reflection in the tray. Nevertheless, I expect the finish to be flawless. In its current state, the imperfections and scratches take away from its beauty and make it not giftable. This was packaged extremely well, so the issue stems from the manufacturing process. The $50 price combined with the lack of flawless finish is the reason I took off two stars; in every other way it is perfect.
